quizzes.title: $\frac{\sin 3x + \sin x}{\cos 3x + \cos x}$ trigonometrik ifodani soddalashtiring.
quizzes.explanation: Yig'indini ko'paytmaga keltiramiz: $\sin 3x + \sin x = 2\sin 2x \cos x$ va $\cos 3x + \cos x = 2\cos 2x \cos x$. Ularning nisbati: $\frac{2\sin 2x \cos x}{2\cos 2x \cos x} = \tan 2x$.

quizzes.title: Agar $\log_2 3 = a$ bo'lsa, $\log_{12} 18$ ni $a$ orqali ifodalang.
Arifmetik progressiyada $a_4 + a_8 + a_{12} + a_{16} = 224$ bo'lsa, dastlabki $19$ ta hadi yig'indisi $S_{19}$ ni toping.
Hadlari musbat bo'lgan geometrik progressiyada $b_2 \cdot b_4 \cdot b_6 = 64$ bo'lsa, $b_4$ ning qiymatini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Geometrik progressiya xossasiga ko'ra $b_2 \cdot b_6 = b_4^2$. Demak, $b_2 \cdot b_4 \cdot b_6 = b_4^3 = 64 \implies b_4 = 4$.

quizzes.title: Cheksiz kamayuvchi geometrik progressiya hadlarining yig'indisi $16$ ga, hadlarining kvadratlari yig'indisi esa $\frac{512}{3}$ ga teng. Uning birinchi hadi $b_1$ ni toping.
$20\%$ li $40\text{ litr}$ tuzli eritmaga qancha litr toza suv qo'shilsa, eritmadagi tuz miqdori $16\%$ bo'ladi?
quizzes.explanation: Eritmadagi tuz miqdori: $40 \cdot 0.20 = 8\text{ litr}$. Qo'shilgan suv hajmi $x$ bo'lsin: $\frac{8}{40 + x} = 0.16 \implies 40 + x = 50 \implies x = 10\text{ litr}$.

quizzes.title: Ikki velosipedchi orasidagi masofa $90\text{ km}$. Ular bir vaqtda bir-biriga qarab yo'lga chiqishdi va $3\text{ soat}$ dan so'ng uchrashishdi. Agar birining tezligi ikkinchisidan $6\text{ km/soat}$ katta bo'lsa, tezroq harakatlangan velosipedchining tezligini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Yaqinlashish tezligi: $v_1 + v_2 = \frac{90}{3} = 30\text{ km/soat}$. Shuningdek $v_1 - v_2 = 6$. Tenglamalarni qo'shsak: $2v_1 = 36 \implies v_1 = 18\text{ km/soat}$.

quizzes.title: $x^2 - 2(a+1)x + a^2 - 3 = 0$ kvadrat tenglama ikkita haqiqiy ildizga ega bo'ladigan $a$ parametrning eng kichik butun qiymatini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Diskriminant: $D/4 = (a+1)^2 - (a^2 - 3) = a^2 + 2a + 1 - a^2 + 3 = 2a + 4 \ge 0 \implies 2a \ge -4 \implies a \ge -2$. Eng kichik butun qiymat $-2$.

quizzes.title: $\sqrt{x + 1} + \sqrt{2x + 3} = 5$ irratsional tenglamaning ildizini toping.
quizzes.explanation: $x = 3$ qo'yib tekshiramiz: $\sqrt{3+1} + \sqrt{2(3)+3} = \sqrt{4} + \sqrt{9} = 2 + 3 = 5$. Chap tomon qat'iy o'suvchi funksiya bo'lgani sababli boshqa ildiz mavjud emas.

quizzes.title: $\log_2(x^2 - 3x) = 2$ logarifmik tenglamaning barcha haqiqiy ildizlari yig'indisini toping.
quizzes.explanation: $x^2 - 3x = 2^2 = 4 \implies x^2 - 3x - 4 = 0 \implies (x-4)(x+1) = 0$. Ildizlar $x_1 = 4, x_2 = -1$. Har ikkala ildiz uchun $x^2 - 3x = 4 > 0$, demak ikkisi ham aniqlangan. Ildizlar yig'indisi: $4 + (-1) = 3$.

quizzes.title: $\sin 2x = \cos x$ trigonometrik tenglamaning $[0; \pi]$ kesmaga tegishli ildizlari sonini toping.
quizzes.explanation: $2\sin x \cos x - \cos x = 0 \implies \cos x(2\sin x - 1) = 0$. 1) $\cos x = 0 \implies x = \frac{\pi}{2}$. 2) $\sin x = \frac{1}{2} \implies x = \frac{\pi}{6}, x = \frac{5\pi}{6}$. Ushbu $3$ ta ildizning barchasi $[0; \pi]$ kesmaga tegishli.

quizzes.title: $\frac{x^2 - 5x + 6}{x + 1} \le 0$ ratsional tengsizlikning eng katta butun manfiy yechimini toping.
quizzes.explanation: $\frac{(x-2)(x-3)}{x+1} \le 0$. Oraliqlar usuli: $x \in (-\infty; -1) \cup [2; 3]$. Manfiy oraliq $(-\infty; -1)$, undagi eng katta butun son $-2$.

quizzes.title: $4^x - 5 \cdot 2^x + 4 \le 0$ tengsizlikning butun yechimlari sonini toping.
quizzes.explanation: $t = 2^x > 0 \implies t^2 - 5t + 4 \le 0 \implies (t-1)(t-4) \le 0 \implies 1 \le t \le 4$. Demak $1 \le 2^x \le 4 \implies 0 \le x \le 2$. Butun yechimlar $x \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, jami $3$ ta.

quizzes.title: $y = x^3 - 3x + 2$ egri chiziqqa $x_0 = 2$ nuqtasida o'tkazilgan urinmaning burchak koeffitsiyentini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Urinmaning burchak koeffitsiyenti hosilaning berilgan nuqtadagi qiymatiga teng: $k = y'(2)$. $y' = 3x^2 - 3 \implies y'(2) = 3(2^2) - 3 = 12 - 3 = 9$.

quizzes.title: $y = 4 - x^2$ parabola va $y = 0$ to'g'ri chiziq bilan chegaralangan soha yuzini hisoblang.
To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari $6\text{ sm}$ va $8\text{ sm}$ ga teng. To'g'ri burchak uchidan gipotenuzaga tushirilgan balandlik uzunligini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Gipotenuza $c = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = 10\text{ sm}$. Yuza formulasi: $S = \frac{1}{2} a b = \frac{1}{2} c h \implies h = \frac{a b}{c} = \frac{6 \cdot 8}{10} = 4.8\text{ sm}$.

quizzes.title: Uchburchakning ikki tomoni $5\text{ sm}$ va $8\text{ sm}$ ga, ular orasidagi burchak $60^\circ$ ga teng. Uchinchi tomonining uzunligini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Kosinuslar teoremasi: $c^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos 60^\circ = 5^2 + 8^2 - 2(5)(8)(0.5) = 25 + 64 - 40 = 49 \implies c = 7\text{ sm}$.

quizzes.title: Teng yonli trapetsiyaning asoslari $8\text{ sm}$ va $18\text{ sm}$ bo'lib, unga ichki aylana chizilgan. Trapetsiyaning yuzini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Aylanaga tashqi chizilgan teng yonli trapetsiyada yon tomon $c = \frac{a+b}{2} = \frac{8+18}{2} = 13\text{ sm}$. Balandlik $h = \sqrt{13^2 - \left(\frac{18-8}{2}\right)^2} = \sqrt{169 - 25} = 12\text{ sm}$. Yuza: $S = \frac{a+b}{2} \cdot h = 13 \cdot 12 = 156\text{ sm}^2$.

quizzes.title: Aylanadan tashqaridagi $M$ nuqtadan aylanaga $MA$ urinma va $M, B, C$ nuqtalar orqali o'tuvchi kesuvchi o'tkazilgan. Agar $MB = 4\text{ sm}$ va $BC = 5\text{ sm}$ bo'lsa, $MA$ urinmaning uzunligini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasiga ko'ra $MA^2 = MB \cdot MC$. Bu yerda $MC = MB + BC = 4 + 5 = 9\text{ sm}$. Demak, $MA^2 = 4 \cdot 9 = 36 \implies MA = 6\text{ sm}$.

quizzes.title: To'g'ri to'rtburchakli parallelepipedning o'lchovlari $2\text{ sm}$, $3\text{ sm}$ va $6\text{ sm}$ ga teng. Uning bosh diagonali uzunligini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Bosh diagonal formulasi: $d = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2 + c^2} = \sqrt{2^2 + 3^2 + 6^2} = \sqrt{4 + 9 + 36} = \sqrt{49} = 7\text{ sm}$.

quizzes.title: Muntazam to'rtburchakli piramidaning asos tomoni $6\text{ sm}$, balandligi $4\text{ sm}$ ga teng. Piramidaning yon sirti yuzini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Apofema $l = \sqrt{h^2 + (a/2)^2} = \sqrt{4^2 + 3^2} = 5\text{ sm}$. Yon sirt: $S_{yon} = \frac{1}{2} P_{asos} \cdot l = \frac{1}{2} (4 \cdot 6) \cdot 5 = 12 \cdot 5 = 60\text{ sm}^2$.

quizzes.title: $\vec{a}(2; -3; 1)$ va $\vec{b}(1; 2; m)$ vektorlar o'zaro perpendikulyar bo'lsa, $m$ parametrning qiymatini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Vektorlarning perpendikulyarlik sharti: ularning skalyar ko'paytmasi nolga teng bo'lishi kerak. $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 2(1) + (-3)(2) + 1(m) = 2 - 6 + m = 0 \implies m = 4$.

quizzes.title: $10$ nafar o'quvchidan $3$ kishilik jamoani necha xil usulda tanlab olish mumkin?
Qutida $5$ ta oq va $7$ ta qora shar bor. Tavakkaliga bir vaqtda olingan $2$ ta sharning ikkalasi ham oq bo'lish ehtimolligini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Jami sharlar soni: $12$. Jami hollar soni: $C_{12}^2 = \frac{12 \cdot 11}{2} = 66$. Qulay hollar: $C_5^2 = \frac{5 \cdot 4}{2} = 10$. Ehtimollik: $P = \frac{10}{66} = \frac{5}{33}$.

quizzes.title: Uchburchakning tomonlari $a = 12\text{ sm}, b = 15\text{ sm}, c = 18\text{ sm}$. Uzunligi $18\text{ sm}$ bo'lgan tomonga tushirilgan bissektrisa ushbu tomonni qanday uzunlikdagi kesmalarga ajratadi?
quizzes.explanation: Bissektrisa xossasiga ko'ra kesmalar nisbati yondosh tomonlar nisbatiga teng: $\frac{x}{y} = \frac{12}{15} = \frac{4}{5}$. $x + y = 18 \implies 9k = 18 \implies k = 2$. Kesmalar: $x = 8\text{ sm}, y = 10\text{ sm}$.

quizzes.title: Radiusi $R = 6\text{ sm}$ bo'lgan aylanaga tashqi chizilgan muntazam oltiburchakning yuzini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Oltiburchak apofemasi $r = R = 6\text{ sm}$. $r = \frac{a\sqrt{3}}{2} = 6 \implies a = \frac{12}{\sqrt{3}} = 4\sqrt{3}\text{ sm}$. Yuza: $S = 6 \cdot \frac{a^2\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot 48 = 72\sqrt{3}\text{ sm}^2$.

quizzes.title: Balandligi va asosining radiusi teng bo'lgan silindr va konus berilgan. Silindr hajmining konus hajmiga nisbatini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Silindr hajmi: $V_{sil} = \pi R^2 H$. Konus hajmi: $V_{kon} = \frac{1}{3}\pi R^2 H$. Ularning nisbati: $\frac{V_{sil}}{V_{kon}} = 3$.

quizzes.title: $\begin{cases} x + y = 7 \\ x^2 + y^2 = 25 \end{cases}$ tenglamalar sistemasining barcha $(x; y)$ yechimlarida $xy$ ko'paytmaning qiymatini toping.
$|x - 1| + |x - 5| = 8$ tenglamaning barcha ildizlari ko'paytmasini toping.
quizzes.explanation: 1) $x < 1$: $1 - x + 5 - x = 8 \implies 6 - 2x = 8 \implies x = -1$. 2) $1 \le x \le 5$: $x - 1 + 5 - x = 4 \ne 8$ (yechim yo'q). 3) $x > 5$: $x - 1 + x - 5 = 8 \implies 2x - 6 = 8 \implies x = 7$. Ildizlar: $-1$ va $7$. Ko'paytmasi: $-1 \cdot 7 = -7$.

quizzes.title: $f(x) = 3\sin x - 4\cos x + 2$ funksiyaning eng katta qiymatini toping.
quizzes.explanation: $A\sin x + B\cos x$ ifodaning qiymatlar sohasi $[-\sqrt{A^2+B^2}; \sqrt{A^2+B^2}]$. $\sqrt{3^2 + (-4)^2} = 5$. Demak, $-5 \le 3\sin x - 4\cos x \le 5$. Eng katta qiymat: $5 + 2 = 7$.

quizzes.title: Yig'indisi $24$ ga teng bo'lgan ikki musbat sonning ko'paytmasi eng katta bo'lishi uchun bu sonlar qanday bo'lishi kerak?
quizzes.explanation: $x + y = 24 \implies y = 24 - x$. $P(x) = x(24 - x) = 24x - x^2$. Hosilasi $P'(x) = 24 - 2x = 0 \implies x = 12 \implies y = 12$. Sonlar $12$ va $12$.

quizzes.title: Nuqta to'g'ri chiziq bo'ylab $v(t) = 3t^2 - 4t + 1\text{ (m/s)}$ tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda. Uning $t_1 = 1\text{ s}$ dan $t_2 = 3\text{ s}$ gacha bo'lgan vaqt oralig'ida bosib o'tgan masofasini hisoblang.
Muntazam to'rtburchakli piramidaning barcha qirralari o'zaro teng va $a$ ga teng. Uning yon qirrasi va asos tekisligi orasidagi burchak kosinusini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Asos diagonali $d = a\sqrt{2}$, uning yarmi $R = \frac{a\sqrt{2}}{2}$. Yon qirra uzunligi $l = a$. Burchak kosinusi: $\cos \alpha = \frac{R}{l} = \frac{a\sqrt{2}/2}{a} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ (ya'ni $\alpha = 45^\circ$).

quizzes.title: Hajmi $216\text{ sm}^3$ bo'lgan kubga ichki chizilgan sharning radiusini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Kub hajmi: $V = a^3 = 216 \implies a = 6\text{ sm}$. Kubga ichki chizilgan shar radiusi qirraning yarmiga teng: $r = \frac{a}{2} = \frac{6}{2} = 3\text{ sm}$.

quizzes.title: Tekislikdan $12\text{ sm}$ masofada joylashgan nuqtadan tekislikka uzunliklari $13\text{ sm}$ va $15\text{ sm}$ bo'lgan ikkita og'ma o'tkazilgan. Ushbu og'malarning tekislikdagi proyeksiyalari uzunliklari yig'indisini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Perpendikulyar $h = 12\text{ sm}$. 1-proyeksiya: $x_1 = \sqrt{13^2 - 12^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5\text{ sm}$. 2-proyeksiya: $x_2 = \sqrt{15^2 - 12^2} = \sqrt{81} = 9\text{ sm}$. Yig'indisi: $5 + 9 = 14\text{ sm}$.

quizzes.title: Uchlari $A(1; 2; 3)$ va $B(5; 6; 7)$ nuqtalarda bo'lgan $AB$ kesma o'rtasining koordinatalarini toping.
Berilgan sonlar qatori: $4, 7, 7, 8, 10, 12, 15$. Ushbu qatorning medianasi va modasi yig'indisini toping.
quizzes.explanation: Qator o'sish tartibida joylashgan $7$ ta sondan iborat. Mediana: o'rtadagi 4-son, ya'ni $8$. Moda: eng ko'p takrorlangan son, ya'ni $7$. Ularning yig'indisi: $8 + 7 = 15$.
